workloads.current_result: Exact 3B H100 image completed both four-stage workflows. The subsequent controlled official 7B H100 overlay diagnostic completed inference and passed the LPIPS improvement and SSIM regression gates, but frozen temporal and downstream annotation gates failed. A first causal temporal repair improved temporal error but still failed the unchanged limit at 1.3886x bicubic and introduced three critical annotation contradictions.
workloads.remaining_acceptance: The failed repair is retained; no held-out or product/GPU qualification for that candidate. Cursor is diagnosing a new mechanism under the unchanged quality gates. No restoration quality acceptance.

workloads.current_result: The previous image failed fresh registration and its scan remains cancelled/incomplete. Cursor replacement source has passed focused service/archive tests and is completing final source review and the full CPU suite.
workloads.remaining_acceptance: Fresh immutable image construction/qualification, two-L40S plus CPU execution, six matched policy/random pairs, 12 videos, objective results and qualified visual review.

workloads.current_result: Real B200 stock planning and independent numeric replay passed with the d738db0d source overlay. The corrected diagnostic wrapper completed the positive/blocked/malformed controls. The full B200 benchmark then failed during Pinocchio import because libgomp.so.1 was missing, before any benchmark row. An isolated actual Cursor worker is repairing the missing runtime library and preserving durable evidence on benchmark failure; focused and packaging tests have passed.
workloads.remaining_acceptance: Cursor must repair/freeze the image dependency, prove offline benchmark imports and dataset bindings, then rebuild/qualify exact image bytes and complete required B200/RTX coverage and visual review. Diagnostic controls do not qualify the final image.

workloads.current_result: All six standard CPU workflow stages succeeded. Actual decoded RRD/PLY geometry and the unedited ordinary native capture were independently checked against the exact inputs. The input is an attributed synthetic indoor benchmark, not a fresh real-world capture.
workloads.remaining_acceptance: The current image failed unchanged security policy on four fixable critical GLib/Perl vulnerabilities; its complete-byte scan continues. Cursor is repairing packaging, missing mcap notice delivery, evidence privacy/history and a pane-audit error path. A new immutable image must pass applicable qualification. No durable-resume, sim-ready or physical-accuracy claim.

workloads.current_result: Real CPU workload reproduced all 47 upstream-recorded labels across three images and rejected blank/noise controls. Four disclosed controls, four precommitted holdout cases and the three-sheet production census passed; each production sheet scored 0.95. Exact submitted PNGs, visible answers, attribution and hashes are public and anonymously verified.
workloads.remaining_acceptance: PR610 is non-draft and ready for the required merge queue at its unchanged source. Evaluator PR678 still awaits current CI/lifecycle closure. Production census overlap is disclosed; visual acceptance concerns presentation only. No GPU applies to the detector and no public container release is claimed.

workloads.current_result: Live CPU deployment proof accepted; the current test-only repair preserves the reviewed production bytes.
workloads.remaining_acceptance: Current CI and lifecycle closure; existing evidence limits remain explicit.

workloads.current_result: PR #659 admitted a real B200 workload with Nebius storage while retaining Kubernetes compute, and recorded durable artifacts. The later cuRobo metric failure remains recorded.
workloads.remaining_acceptance: Current CI and lifecycle closure. This proves storage admission/transport, not a completed cuRobo benchmark.

workloads.current_result: Accepted f93ddc316 production bytes measured 2.3806x on the generated 16 MiB OCI fixture with identical ledgers and failure/cancellation controls. Current 08ca8c332 adds regression tests only. A real Open3D image scan has one dominant 901.5 MB compressed-layer record using one worker; it remains active and unchanged.
workloads.remaining_acceptance: Current source review, CI and draft lifecycle closure. The fixture speedup does not predict real-image speed. Cursor is investigating a separate large-record improvement; no measured real-image speedup is claimed.
